startupOther.classification: Exact current-target operations outside Root-declared manual/regression scopes; no fictional fixed startup count asserted.

financial.rule: All-target and distinct-tenant run totals include every actual run account, including zero-operation accounts. Manual/regression/startupOther subgroups show accounts linked to their observed operations. Run-account totals count unique run accounts once. Tenant-account totals are mirrored control totals, separately reported and never added again. Financial uncertain state means exact cost UNKNOWN even when output is confirmed.

regressionRetained.label: native-profile-regression
regressionRetained.phaseMeaning: Counts observed now. Any earlier positive/current proof is scoped to the named prior receipt; intentional later fences do not create fresh positive-current evidence. No fixed retained count or new recall is asserted.

coverage.regressionPositiveCurrentness: Use exact earlier native receipt where later intentional fences prevent a new positive read; retained counts do not rerun that proof.

limits: Final Root-declared quiet read, separately bounded complete <=256-row official table snapshots and fresh read-only source checks. Stable selected rows across collection, not a globally atomic transaction. Raw prompts/tool inputs/provider output/vectors/secrets never retained. Confirmed native outputs with UNKNOWN exact cost are not refunds. Actual failed responses/stages and watermark holes remain failures; no invalid output is normalized. Root owns resource cleanup.
